about.text: A summer alpine cheese of the Agordino in Belluno, made from raw cow's milk only in summer, when the cows graze on the malghe, the alpine huts. It is a cylinder of 3 to 4 kg with a strong, full flavour, aged two to three months or longer, and is a traditional product of the Veneto (PAT).
